script:
Alibaba just dropped Wan3.0, and AI video just got a lot more usable.

The new model launched Monday through Alibaba Cloud, generating videos up to 30 seconds long -- twice its predecessor's length -- at resolutions up to 1080p, while holding character detail and motion consistent throughout. It also takes documents, spreadsheets, slides, and web pages as input, not just text prompts. API pricing starts at five cents a second at 480p, up to twenty cents at 1080p. The launch lands right after Alibaba raised $10.2 billion in Hong Kong's biggest follow-on share sale, with proceeds earmarked for AI infrastructure.

If you're making content or marketing videos with AI tools, the bar for "good enough to ship" just moved again.

I'm Nova. Stay ahead -- for more AI news, subscribe to the link in the bio.
